name: Dark Iron Ambassador
summary: The Dark Iron Ambassador is an emissary of the Dark Iron clan found deep within Gnomeregan. His presence raises questions about the clan's interest in the ruined gnome capital.

sections.title: A Shadowy Envoy
sections.body: The Dark Iron Ambassador is found among the dangers of irradiated Gnomeregan. He represents the Dark Iron clan, but the purpose of his mission is not explained.

sections.title: Conspiracies in the Deep
sections.body: Investigators and goblins raise suspicions about Dark Iron involvement in Gnomeregan's troubles and its mysterious super rig. These remain theories; the ambassador's presence does not establish who caused the city's fall or the terms of any agreement.

faq.q: Who is the Dark Iron Ambassador?
faq.answer: He is a Dark Iron emissary found inside Gnomeregan. His precise diplomatic mission is unknown.

faq.q: Why is a Dark Iron dwarf inside Gnomeregan?
aliases: why are dark irons in gnomeregan
faq.answer: His purpose is not established. His presence shows that the Dark Iron clan has an interest in Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Did the Dark Irons help cause the fall of Gnomeregan?
aliases: did dark irons cause trogg invasion
faq.answer: That is not established. Investigators have raised suspicions, but their theories do not prove who caused the disaster.

faq.q: Where does the ambassador come from?
faq.answer: He belongs to the Dark Iron clan, whose ruler is Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

faq.q: Is he allied with Sicco Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: An alliance is suspected, but no confirmed agreement is established by his presence alone.

faq.q: Where can the Dark Iron Ambassador be found?
faq.answer: He is an elusive, rare encounter who wanders the contaminated engineering sectors and workshop corridors inside the Gnomeregan dungeon.

angles.text: A Dark Iron emissary in Gnomeregan raises troubling questions for gnome investigators.
The presence of a Dark Iron dwarf in the ruined gnome city draws the attention of Ironforge allies.
Alliance investigators have reason to examine the Dark Iron presence in Gnomeregan.
